entries.title: Household Water Treatment Reference
entries.summary: Static household reminder for keeping untreated water, treated water, and storage containers clearly separated during disruptions.

sections.title: Separate The Flow
sections.bodyMarkdown:
- Keep untreated source water and treated water in different containers.
- Use one clearly marked lane for cooled treated water only.
sections.plainText: Keep untreated source water and treated water in different containers. Use one clearly marked lane for cooled treated water only.

sections.title: Protect The Containers
sections.bodyMarkdown:
- Cover treated water while it cools.
- Label date and intended use before it goes back into daily circulation.
sections.plainText: Cover treated water while it cools. Label date and intended use before it goes back into daily circulation.

sections.title: Keep It Simple
sections.bodyMarkdown:
- If the routine gets confusing, pause and simplify before more people start using the water.
- A smaller known-safe supply is better than a larger mixed supply.
sections.plainText: If the routine gets confusing, pause and simplify before more people start using the water. A smaller known-safe supply is better than a larger mixed supply.
